test_families.name: Passage provenance
expert: passage is legally sufficient and not misleading

test_families.name: Accessibility and plain language
expert: legal fidelity, cognitive accessibility and translation quality

test_families.name: AI answer evaluation
automated: schema, links, passages, dates, source types, citation coverage
expert: correctness, controlling authority, reasoning, balance, professional boundary

test_families.name: Expert review protocol
expert: two reviewers for critical strata; adjudication of disagreement; signed review record

scoring.hard_failure_policy: Any hard failure caps the answer at 49/100; invented authority, wrong jurisdiction or wrong version in a consequential answer caps at 0 and blocks release.

expert_review_protocol.reviewers: Qualified lawyers appropriate to jurisdiction/source plus legal-information specialist
expert_review_protocol.sampling: All high-consequence failures; at least 20% of each critical stratum; double review of treatment and current-law questions
expert_review_protocol.independence: Reviewer must not be the author of the adapter/answer under review
expert_review_protocol.disagreement: Adjudicated and retained as evidence; benchmark gold may remain plural/conditional
expert_review_protocol.refresh: Gold answers revalidated on source change or at least quarterly for current-law strata.
